recording.lineage: Recorded & Transfered By: Robert Mullen; Source: Master Audience Cassettes; This was recorded with 2 sets of mics input to a 4 channel mixer down to 2 channels into the recorder. recording.lineage: Recorded by Dave Cohen and Justin Lee 2 Nakamichi CM300 Omnis Spaced at 2 meters>Nakamichi 550 w/dolby B Maxell XLIIS90s cassettes 3/4 of the way back in OTS, DFC; The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby Decoded on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). FLAC'd using Audiofile Engineering Sample Manager. Transfer by Dave Cohen
